header.authors_and_contributors: Meire Ribeiro Domingos, Daniel Flórez-Orrego, EPFL IPESE research group
header.reference_capacity: 21,026 kg/h of oxygen (OXYGEN), 505 t/day, and 86,417 kg/h of nitrogen (NITROGEN)
header.description: Cryogenic double-column air separation unit producing oxygen (99.5 % molar) and nitrogen at 1 bar, with compressors that bring the oxygen to 30 or 200 bar and the nitrogen to 7 or 200 bar.

units.unit_description: This unit separates air into an oxygen-rich stream, 21,026 kg/h at 99.5 % O2 (molar), and a nitrogen-rich stream, 86,417 kg/h, both at 1 bar and 30 °C. The air is compressed to 7.45 bar in four intercooled stages, cooled in the main heat exchanger and separated in a high-pressure and a low-pressure column; two expanders recover part of the power. It takes 6,054 kW of electricity.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes electricity, and delivers oxygen and nitrogen at 1 bar, which are vented or compressed by the four compressor units. The air is drawn from the atmosphere and is not given as a connector.

connectors.description: Oxygen-rich stream, 99.5 % O2 (molar), to be vented or compressed

connectors.name: NITROVENT
connectors.description: Nitrogen-rich stream, 93 % N2, to be vented or compressed
